summary: Implemented core game functionality across API, Web, and Mobile. Users can now create, discover, and join/leave games with capacity and join policy enforcement.

environment_readiness.infra_evidence: PostgreSQL and Redis containers are healthy.

major_decisions.decision: Implemented a status-based lifecycle (OPEN, CANCELLED, COMPLETED) with participant roles (HOST, PARTICIPANT).
major_decisions.reason: Allows for clear state transitions and permission checks.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Initially simplified to manually triggered transitions; automatic completion based on endTime can be added later.

major_decisions.decision: Added automatic waitlist promotion when an approved participant leaves.
major_decisions.reason: Ensures games remain full without host intervention.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Requires careful concurrency handling (best-effort implemented via Prisma transactions).

tests.name: API Games Tests
tests.notes: Covers create, list, and join (open policy).

tests.name: Mobile Games Smoke Test
tests.notes: Verifies basic rendering in headless mode.

acceptance_checklist.evidence: API and Web implementations exist and are tested.
GET /games supports sportId and homeArea filtering.
Implemented in join/leave endpoints with waitlist logic.
